Load the data from the Harvard Dataverse

load_data.Rd

Load the data from the Harvard Dataverse

Usage

load_data(file_name = NULL, file_note = NULL)

Arguments

file_name

The exact file name for a particular dataset. Please use view_data() to find this information.

file_note

The exact note for a particular dataset. Please use view_data() to find this information.

Value

df A particular dataset
